pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal regions with sharp, angular edges and narrow pixel gradients. Spatial area of patches is relatively large on the lower neck and reduces in size toward the dorsal ridge.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous topological mesh of light-colored space. Junction nodes are predominantly tri-radial with variable pathway thickness that narrows between patch vertices.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Continuous 1D mane silhouette exhibiting a high-frequency, low-amplitude serrated pattern against the background sky.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple dark avian silhouettes (oxpeckers) clustered on the lateral surface of the neck and shoulder.
